Title: Gwen Stefani Still Rocks Her Iconic No Doubt Outfit 25 Years Later
Summary: Gwen Stefani marks 25 years of No Doubt's feminist anthem 'Just a Girl' by recreating her iconic 1995 music video fashion look—featuring a cropped red-and-blue striped tank top, baggy blue track pants, pompadour ponytail, and signature red lipstick.

Title: The Best-Dressed Stars at Coachella Weekend One
Summary: Recaps standout celebrity looks from Weekend One of Coachella 2024, spotlighting No Doubt frontwoman Gwen Stefani performing in a distressed plaid punk-rock ensemble alongside special guest Olivia Rodrigo in a vintage 'I Heart ND' tank top and studded belt.

Title: Our Top 15 Coachella Fits From The First Weekend
Summary: Curates top festival fashion outfits from Coachella 2024, spotlighting Gwen Stefani's funky plaid jumpsuit paired with glittery Dr. Martens boots, as well as Olivia Rodrigo joining No Doubt's stage branded in the band's initials.

Title: The best celebrity fashion at Coachella 2024
Summary: Highlights major celebrity fashion moments at Coachella 2024, featuring Gwen Stefani's punk-rock festival style during No Doubt's reunion set on stage with Olivia Rodrigo.

Title: Usher con 394 mil cristales en su traje Off White para el show de medio tiempo del Super Bowl
Summary: Explores Usher's multi-outfit fashion wardrobe at the 2024 Super Bowl LVIII Halftime Show, detailing his initial white Dolce & Gabbana jewel-adorned look with Portofino kicks, a custom Jacquie Aiche diamond pendant, and an Off-White biker suit encrusted with 394,000 crystals paired with bespoke roller skates.

Title: Met Gala 2024: Only the Best Menswear Looks
Summary: Highlights leading menswear looks at the 2024 Met Gala ('The Garden of Time'), featuring Usher in an all-black custom Alexander McQueen design by Seán McGirr with a dramatic cape, wide-brim hat, and single red rose.

Title: The 100 best dressed men in Met Gala history
Summary: Chronicles iconic menswear moments throughout Met Gala history, including Usher's 2023 Karl Lagerfeld tribute red-carpet look designed by Bianca Saunders.

Title: The best looks at the 2024 Met Gala after parties
Summary: Details after-party attire from the 2024 Met Gala, spotlighting Usher hosting his 'Secret Garden' themed after-party at the Times Square Edition.

Title: The Best-Dressed Pop Girlies At Glastonbury 2025
Summary: Rounds up festival looks from Glastonbury 2025: Charli XCX turned an Alexander McQueen skull scarf into a halter top, Doechii wore custom Vivienne Westwood and Joy Crookes wore a safety-pinned gown by Jawara Alleyne, alongside Olivia Rodrigo, Lorde, PinkPantheress and Gracie Abrams.

Title: Examining Charli XCX's Audacious Style Beyond The Brat Aesthetic
Summary: Traces Charli XCX's wardrobe beyond the Brat era: a sparkly Balenciaga dress, a Saint Laurent leather jacket at the brand's pre-Oscars party, a patchwork vintage T-shirt gown by Marni at the 2024 Met Gala, Gaultier couture at the 2023 Fashion Awards and a Coperni hoodie-and-skirt set in Paris.

Title: Moda Brat: los esenciales para vestir con lo aesthetic de Charli XCX
Summary: A Spanish-language guide to dressing in the Brat aesthetic popularised by Charli XCX's album, from its signature neon green to her suggestion that a white tank top with no bra can be enough; no designer is credited with dressing her.

Title: Kid Cudi is Letting it All Go
Summary: An interview with Kid Cudi about his debut Calvin Klein campaign, his own clothing line Members of the Rage and the varsity jackets he makes and wears, and listening to Ratatat and MGMT on photo shoots.

Title: Men's Skirts Are Ready for the Mainstream
Summary: Argues the skirt has reached mainstream menswear, citing Kid Cudi in a Nirvana T-shirt and black maxi skirt, A$AP Rocky in a Givenchy leather skirt, Jaden Smith in Louis Vuitton and Thom Browne's skirted tailoring, with runway precedents from Jean Paul Gaultier, Raf Simons and Rick Owens.

Title: HM Channels Brat For Its A/W 2024 Collection
Summary: Announces H&M's autumn/winter 2024 collection featuring Charli XCX, following the retailer's earlier collaboration with designer Anamika Khanna.

Title: Olivia Rodrigo Is Giving Us Peak Pop Girlie Fashion
Summary: Charts Olivia Rodrigo's recent stage style: a custom Dilara Fındıkoğlu corset and mini skirt at Glastonbury 2025, a custom Michael Schmidt sparkle set on the Guts World Tour, and a plaid skirt with a band tee when she joined Paramore at Coachella 2024, with a photo of No Doubt's Gwen Stefani from the same festival.

Title: The Evolution Of The Super Bowl Halftime Costume
Summary: Looks back at three decades of Super Bowl halftime wardrobes, from Diana Ross's gold coat and Katy Perry's Jeremy Scott costumes to Rihanna's red jumpsuit and Usher performing shirtless at the 2024 show.

Title: Charli XCX's Electric Coachella Set Included Duets With Billie Eilish and Lorde
Summary: Recaps Charli XCX's 2025 Coachella set, where Billie Eilish joined her for the live debut of the Guess remix and Lorde sang Girl, So Confusing; at a party beforehand Charli wore a mesh tank, long skirt and boots with a Chanel handbag.

Title: Top 15 Fashion Moments From Met Gala 2021 First Edition
Summary: Picks the standout looks of the 2021 Met Gala, including Billie Eilish's Oscar de la Renta ball gown with Cartier diamond earrings, Lil Nas X in layered Versace, A$AP Rocky draped in an ERL quilt and Rihanna in Balenciaga.

Title: Met Gala 2025: Only the Best Tailored Looks
Summary: Highlights the tailoring at the 2025 Met Gala, from Usher in Ralph Lauren Purple Label and Pharrell Williams in Louis Vuitton to Grace Wales Bonner dressing Lewis Hamilton and Omar Apollo, Ozwald Boateng's patterned suiting, Bad Bunny in Prada and Doja Cat in Marc Jacobs.

Title: Bad Bunny's Superbowl Outfit Proved That Zara Has Outgrown the High Street
Summary: Argues that Bad Bunny's all-Zara Super Bowl halftime look, a cream mock jersey with matching trousers, marks the high-street brand's arrival, contrasting earlier headliners Rihanna in Loewe and Usher in Dolce & Gabbana; Lady Gaga appeared in a Luar dress.

Title: Usher’s 2025 Met Gala Look Was Inspired by the Harlem Renaissance—and His Grandfather
Summary: Usher wore custom Ralph Lauren Purple Label designed in collaboration with Polo Ralph Lauren creative director James Jeter for the 2025 Met Gala.

Title: Usher’s 2025 Met Gala Scarf Was a Dandy Touch Done Right
Summary: Usher went classic for the 2025 Met Gala: a black three-piece Ralph Lauren suit, finished with a white scarf for a dandy touch. Harper's Bazaar also revisits Usher's 2024 custom Alexander McQueen look by Seán McGirr, alongside a Jacob & Co. watch.

Title: How Usher’s Super Bowl LVIII Show Put Roller-Rink Culture on the World Stage
Summary: Usher wore custom Off-White during his Super Bowl LVIII halftime show, and his dancers wore pieces from an official Usher and Flipper’s capsule created with Liberty Ross.

Title: Usher Is the New Face of Skims. Yeah, Man.
Summary: Usher is the new face of Skims and fronts the Skims Mens campaign, appearing in a range of Skims apparel.

Title: Usher Gets Theatrical in McQueen at the Met Gala
Summary: Usher wore a theatrical custom Alexander McQueen cloak-and-tux ensemble on the 2024 Met Gala red carpet.

Title: Usher on Childhood Scents, Oprah’s Wisdom, and His Philosophy on Love
Summary: Usher is the face of Ralph’s Club New York Eau de Parfum from Ralph Lauren Fragrances, according to the interview.

Title: Inside Thom Browne’s Enchanting, Romantic Universe
Summary: Thom Browne's Fall/Winter 2023 New York show at The Shed was built around The Little Prince, with a crashed biplane on a black-sand runway. The tailoring went oversized, then deconstructed: twisted lapels, pasted-on sleeves, shirts and jackets merged into skirts, puffed shoulder-pad volumes and subverted tweed. White column dresses carried embroidered planets and stars, and the show closed on Precious Lee in a white suit dress.

Title: Janelle Monáe's Met Gala Fashion Streak Continues in Custom Thom Browne
Summary: For the 2025 Met Gala, 'Superfine: Tailoring Black Style,' Janelle Monáe wore custom Thom Browne made with Oscar-winning costume designer Paul Tazewell: a black, red and white pinstripe suit with sharp pointed shoulders, a black top hat and a small black-and-gold clock worn over one eye, and she revealed a tequila-derived diamond brooch on her tie partway through the night.
